evd_title: Swapping the facet-based RankGPT re-ranker for a general-relevance RankGPT dropped not-novel prediction accuracy from 89.66% to 13.79%
finding: Swapping the facet-based RankGPT re-ranker for a general-relevance RankGPT dropped not-novel prediction accuracy from 89.66% to 13.79%
P: 58 not-novel ideas (13 from test set + 45 published NLP papers)
I: Idea Novelty Checker complete pipeline with facet-based RankGPT (gpt-4o re-ranking, o3-mini novelty evaluation)
C: Ablations: general-relevance RankGPT, embedding filtering only, snippet only, keyword only
O: Not-novel accuracy: complete 89.66% vs relevance RankGPT 13.79%, embedding-only 10.34%, snippet 8.62%, keyword 5.17%
T: Not reported for ablation (o3-mini used); paper 2025
